rag.question: Why is invoice INV-7781 on hold?
rag.answer:
1. Price ₹412.00 is 3.5% above PO ₹398.00. Contract C-22 (01-Oct-2026) sets ₹412.00, so the PO looks outdated. Likely cause: PO not updated after contract change (supported by evidence). Smallest fix: Passes if the PO price is amended to ₹412.00 per C-22.
2. Invoice quantity 40 nos is above receipts of 32 nos. Delivery note DN-5521 shows 40 nos delivered. Likely cause: Goods receipt under-posted (supported by evidence). Smallest fix: Passes if Warehouse posts the missing 8 nos receipt (DN-5521 shows 40 nos delivered).
What the documents say: Goods are payable only for the quantity accepted at inspection. If part of a delivery is rejected, the supplier must issue a credit note or corrected invoice for the rejected quantity, or Quality must record a documented concession. The invoiced quantity may not exceed the accepted quantity by more than 5 percent. Goods received but not yet inspected are held until inspection is recorded. [POL-AP-02, §1] Amendment to contract C-22 with Vihar Chem Supplies: price of AX-40 changed from ₹398.00 to ₹412.00, effective 2026-10-01, signed 2026-09-17. Annual price revision Purchase orders raised before 2026-10-01 keep the old price until the buyer amends them. [Contract C-22, amendment effective 2026-10-01] For materials bought by weight, the weighbridge net weight must agree with the goods receipt weight within 1 percent. If the weighbridge shows less than the goods receipt or the invoice, Logistics confirms a re-weigh and the goods receipt or invoice is corrected before payment. [POL-AP-03, §1]
